proved.statement: For a 3-coordinate symmetric center B and rank-two cross block K with unit v spanning ker K^T and Bv=0, adj(B)=c vv^T and adj(KK^T)=Delta^2 vv^T. Thus det B_hatk=c v_k^2 and det(K_hatk K_hatk^T)=Delta^2 v_k^2 for every deletion k; one physical pair simultaneously carries at least |c|/3 self determinant and Delta/sqrt(3) cross area.

The family A=[[eps u1u1^T+delta vv^T, U V_m^T],[V_m U^T,0]] has at least three eigenvalues of modulus >=1, enters strict N3 for small eps,delta and large m, has local partner d=delta,g=0, yet is uniformly controlled by source Theorem H (<5.265) and by the newest account03/B01 determinant-area receiver (<=2sqrt(pi)<3.545).
